simple.meaning: כַּרְבְּלָא (karbᵉlâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a mantle.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H3737. karbela [ כַּרְבְּלָא ] noun feminine probably helmet, cap (> al. mantle , e.g. K § 62 ; see Dr) (Late Hebrew כַּרְבָּלָה comb of cock; so Jewish-Aramaic כַּרְבָּלְתָא , Syriac ; Assyrian karballatu , cap Andr M 67 * , Muss-Arn Assyrian Dict. 436 a ; so SAC JPhii. xxvi. 310 f. , compare Biblical Hebrew [ כרבל ]); — plural suffix כַּרְבְּלָֽתְהוֺן Dan 3:21 .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from a verb corresponding to that of 3736 ;
